title: 氵 water (三点水)
intro: 氵 is the squeezed form of 水 (water) and always sits on the left. Its three dots are written top to bottom; the last one flicks up. A character with 氵 is usually about liquids, water bodies, washing or flowing.

ex.p: nà tiáo hé hěn cháng
ex.en: That river is very long.

ex.zh: 黄河是中国第二长的河。
ex.p: huáng hé shì zhōng guó dì èr cháng de hé
ex.en: The Yellow River is China's second-longest river.

ex.zh: 我们周末去海边游泳吧。
ex.p: wǒ men zhōu mò qù hǎi biān yóu yǒng ba
ex.en: Let's go swimming at the beach this weekend.

ex.p: wǒ xiǎng qù hǎi biān kàn kàn dà hǎi
ex.en: I want to go to the seaside to see the ocean.

ex.en: I shower every morning.

ex.p: chī fàn yǐ qián yào xiān xǐ shǒu
ex.en: Wash your hands before eating.

ex.en: It's OK, we'll go to the lake tomorrow.

汤.h: 氵 + 汤's right part (also in 场, 烫)

没.h: 氵 + 殳 (a hand with a tool)

lines.p: wǒ jiā páng biān yǒu yī gè hú

lines.zh: 夏天的时候，我常常和朋友去湖里游泳。
lines.p: xià tiān de shí hou wǒ cháng cháng hé péng you qù hú lǐ yóu yǒng

lines.zh: 游完泳，我们都很饿，就去湖边的小饭馆喝汤。
lines.p: yóu wán yǒng wǒ men dōu hěn è jiù qù hú biān de xiǎo fàn guǎn hē tāng

lines.zh: 那里的鱼汤很清，也很好喝。
lines.p: nà li de yú tāng hěn qīng yě hěn hǎo hē

lines.zh: 我朋友喜欢喝啤酒，可是我不喝酒，我喝茶。
lines.p: wǒ péng you xǐ huan hē pí jiǔ kě shì wǒ bù hē jiǔ wǒ hē chá

exercises.why: 洒 (sǎ) means sprinkle; 酒 has the extra stroke inside
Clear is water (氵) not speech (讠)
胡 is only the sound part; a lake needs 氵
干 is only the sound part

o: 喜欢，我常常去海边游泳。

lessons.title: 字的结构 · How characters are built
lessons.html:
Almost every character is built from a small set of reusable parts, arranged in a few fixed layouts. Learn the parts and the layouts, and new characters stop being random pictures.

The eight layouts (字的结构)

LayoutChinese nameExamples
Left + right左右结构好 明 河
Top + bottom上下结构字 花 老
Left + middle + right左中右结构树 谢 班
Top + middle + bottom上中下结构意 类
Half-enclosed (covered from one corner or side)半包围结构病 这 问 同 区 画
Fully enclosed全包围结构国 回 园
Single unit (cannot be split)独体字人 木 日 大
Three-part pile品字结构品 森 众

Meaning part + sound part (形声字). Most characters, over 80%, pair a radical that hints at the meaning with a component that hints at the sound. The radical tells you the category; the other part tells you roughly how to say it. Watch one sound part, 青 qīng, change meaning as the radical changes:

CharacterRadical (meaning)PinyinMeaning
清氵 waterqīngclear (like water)
请讠 speechqǐngplease, invite
情忄 heartqíngfeeling
晴日 sunqíngsunny
睛目 eyejīngeyeball
精米 ricejīngrefined, essence

Where a radical sits, and what it is called

PositionChinese termExample radical and its name
Left side旁 (páng)氵 三点水, 扌 提手旁
Top头 (tóu)艹 草字头, 宀 宝盖头
Bottom底 (dǐ)心 心字底, 辶 走之底
Frame框 (kuàng)口 国字框, 门 门字框

Five stroke-order rules that cover most characters

  1. Top before bottom (三, 花).
  2. Left before right (河, 明).
  3. Horizontal before vertical when they cross (十, 干).
  4. Outside before inside, then close the frame last (国, 回).
  5. 辶 and 廴 are written last (这, 远, 建).
